entry_points.summary: Agent metadata declares lookup role, model, and tool allowlist.
Fixed STATUS-headed Markdown envelope and required sections.
Regex patterns that force STATUS: refused before Bash runs.
Total response cap and raw-artifact cache behavior.
freshness_ts is retrieval time; stale cache lowers confidence.
Fallback, pagination, no-result, and auth-missing behavior.

invariants: First output line is exactly STATUS: ok|partial|refused.
Sections are ordered Answer, Provenance, Unresolved, optional Raw artifact pointer.
Total response, including STATUS and sections, is <=3 KB.
Answer summarizes and cites; raw HTML/JSON/YAML goes to raw artifact pointer.
Bash commands are checked against verb-blocklist before execution.
Executed Bash commands are recorded verbatim in provenance.commands.
freshness_ts is retrieval time in UTC, not source last-modified time.
gotchas: docs/llm/lookup-contract.json wins over inline agent prose on conflicts.
Refused Answer first line must be Refused: <category> - <detail>.
Fetch 4xx/5xx, no results, stale cache, and pagination gaps are partial.
Auth-required endpoints without secrets are refused as auth_missing.
Do not sniff env vars for credentials when auth is missing.
Cache key query is lowercase, whitespace-collapsed, and trimmed.
